Row alignment is loose in print: the Territory column runs as 22 separate lines (Hunan / Kwangtung / Shensi Kansu / Hopei / Kiangsu Anhwei / Kiangsi Hunan / Kiangsu Anhwei / Chekiang Fukien / Kwangtung / Kwangtung Kwangsi / Fukien Kiangsi / Kwangtung / Kweichow Yunnan / Hunan Kweichow / Yunnan / Suiyuan Kansu / Szechwan / Shantung / Hopei Honan / Shensi / Hunan Kwangsi / Kwangtung) and the figures sit on some of those lines, not always level with their line name. There are exactly 14 line names, 14 lengths and 14 costs, so the figures are matched to the lines in order. The Territory lines are grouped by the transcriber by that alignment and by geography. In Group I the printed figures sit one line lower than their line name (e.g. 657 / 78,650,000 are level with 'Hopei', 138 with the first 'Kiangsu Anhwei', 6145 with 'Kiangsi Hunan'). Grouping the territories is an interpretation; check the scan if it matters.
The Group labels (I.–IV.) are placed as printed: 'II.' stands level with Nanking-Canton, but the list on p. 358 (p0719_1) puts Nanking-Changsha in Group II.

Character column: the printed 'do' (ditto) is kept; 'alterative' is printed as it stands. The Character of Canton-Hankow is printed on the same line as '(Chuchow-', so it reads 'Canton-Hankow (Chuchow-Previously projected / Shiuchow section).' The Line column has been rebuilt as 'Canton-Hankow (Chuchow-Shiuchow section).'
Length for Nanking-Changsha is printed '6145' (probably 614.5, with the point dropped); Canton-Yunnan is printed '1312,5'. Both are kept as printed.
